It should not treat the line as a description of the whole country or as a law binding the states, since neither is in the arrangement, and it should note that a rule drawn across territory later proved impossible to apply to a state lying on both sides of it.
questions.hint: Ask which land the rule was written for and which land it never mentioned.

answer.exemplar: It was issued as a measure of war against those still resisting, so its authority was a commander's power over the enemy and nothing more, and a power to act on the population of loyal states was neither claimed nor held; the durable ending had to come from a change in the constitution itself, which is why an amendment was needed before the claim could stand on its own.

questions.explanation: A strong answer ties the measure's limits to the office that issued it, since a commander at war reaches the enemy and not a loyal state, and notes that the amendment was what made the change permanent and nationwide. It should not rest on the presence of any compromise or on the result of any election, and it should acknowledge that the war measure still mattered, because it changed the meaning of the war and the status of people reaching the armies.

answer.exemplar: The amendment forbade denial on stated grounds of race and colour, and a test or a tax named neither, so a court could read the ban as resting on the words a state used and put on the man refused the burden of showing his colour was the reason; the later statutes supplied the officers and trials the amendment never created, which is why enforcement fell as they lapsed.

questions.explanation: A strong answer locates the mechanism in the wording and in who had to prove what, then links the rise and fall of enforcement to the statutes and officers rather than to the amendment's text. It should not blame the freed people for a claim they did not make, and it should acknowledge the years in which the vote was defended, since the change came from a narrow reading and the withdrawal of federal officers rather than from anything the amendment said.
